caption: The drawing displays two distinct views of a single earring, centrally positioned on a light beige background. The left side shows a front view of the earring, which has a dark brown and amber color, shaped with an ornate top section narrowing before joining a large, rounded hoop that tapers into a point at the bottom. The right side depicts a side view of the same earring, illustrating its thickness and the hooked wire for fastening, with the brown and amber tones also visible. Four faint, rectangular marks—their color a blurred yellowish-brown—appear near the corners of the central space. A small signature in reddish-brown ink or paint is present at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Earrings
